verdict.rationale: Babylon.js includes a built-in ActionManager system that lets developers declare triggers (e.g., clicks, intersections) and associated actions, which is the closest analog to 'rules triggering actions on events'; this is only evidenced by a single brief community mention, not first-party documentation in the evidence pack. missing for 10: dedicated docs on ActionManager/trigger syntax, AI-native tooling or examples for defining such rules, independent corroboration beyond one forum comment.
